{{ArcaneBox}}
'''Arcane Pistoleer''' is an [[Arcane Enhancement]] that provides a chance on killing an enemy with a weak point hit from a secondary weapon to grant [[Infinite Ammo]] for 12 seconds.

Can be sold for {{cc|‍1,000}}.

==Effect==
{| class="emodtable"

! [[Arcane Enhancement#Rank|Rank]]
! Chance for Infinite Ammo

|-

|-
| 3 || +40%
|-
| 4 || +50%
|-
| 5 || +60%
|}

{{Clr}}
{{Acquisition|
*Awarded from [[Arbitrations]] missions.
*Can be purchased from the Arbitrations vendor in the {{Faction|Arbiters of Hexis}} room in [[Relay]]s for 10 {{Resource|Vitus Essence}}.}}

==Notes==
*After being activated by the secondary, the buff also works on primary weapons.
**The buff doesn't affect special weapons, like the [[Thermian RPG]].
**Getting another proc does not refresh the timer. The current instance of Arcane Pistoleer must run out before another can be started.
* In order for the arcane to activate enemy must be killed with direct damage, {{D|Gas}} or {{D|Electricity}} status effects. Other damage over time effects will not trigger the buff.
*Alt-fire modes that shoot all remaining bullets in an automatic burst ({{Weapon|Cyanex}}, {{Weapon|Nagantaka}}, or {{Weapon|Pandero}}) shoot the ''current'' number of bullets left in the magazine while conserving them, allowing for an ammo-efficient, repeated use of these modes.
**{{Weapon|Azima}} alt-fire still consumes the entire magazine as normal, but the turrets themselves benefit from '''''partial''''' ammo efficiency, expending their ammo more slowly and therefore lasting much longer. However, 100% ammo efficiency does not benefit turrets in any way and they will last their normal duration.
*Is also capable of being toggled by pistol [[Exalted Weapon]]s like the {{Weapon|Dex Pixia}}.

==Tips==
*Can greatly improve the performance of weapons that otherwise have low magazine size like {{Weapon|Akbronco}} ({{Weapon|Akbronco Prime|Prime}}) or {{Weapon|Twin Rogga}}.
**The same applies to primaries like ({{Weapon|Sancti Tigris|Sancti}}) {{Weapon|Tigris}} ({{Weapon|Tigris Prime|Prime}}), ({{Weapon|Kuva Tonkor|Kuva}}){{Weapon|Tonkor}}, and {{Weapon|Vectis}} ({{Weapon|Vectis Prime|Prime}}).
*Synergizes well with {{Weapon|Pyrana Prime}}'s passive, allowing the wielder to make more use of the fire rate/akimbo buff ''without'' sacrificing the buff's duration to reloads.
*Since {{WF|Banshee}}'s {{A|Sonar}} can create weakpoints in any given part of an enemy, the effect from thir arcane can be triggered by any non-precision weapon hitting any highlighted part of enemies.
**Particularly effective with high area of effect secondaries, such as the {{Weapon|Akarius}} ({{Weapon|Akarius Prime|Prime}}).

==Patch History==
{{Scrollbox/Article|
{{ver|44.1.3}}
*Sources that intentionally gave 100% Ammo Efficiency (ex: Void Relic cracking buffs) have now been rephrased to indicate they give Infinite Ammo.
*Arcane Pistoleer
**<u>Was:</u> On Pistol Weak Point Kill: 60% chance for +102% (+17% at Unranked) Ammo Efficiency for 12s
**<u>Now:</u> On Pistol Weak Point Kill: 60% (10% at Unranked) Chance for Infinite Ammo for 12s

{{ver|44.0}}
*Converted the trigger from “On Headshot” to “On Weakpoint”
*Fixed Arcane Pistoleer having a file path description. 

{{ver|41.0.4}}
*Fixed performance issues caused by the Akarius with Arcane Pistoleer equipped.

{{ver|38.6}}
*Arbitration rotation rewards (excluding Omni Forma) have been added to the Arbitration store (Arbiters of Hexis in the Relay) to provide players an easier path to these items via Vitus Essence.

{{ver|31.6}}
;ARCANE STAT CHANGES PER RANK

We’ve adjusted the values of older Arcanes with the goal of making lower rank Arcanes more viable, and more desirable while collecting as a result. In short, there are three stats that each Arcane tends to have (speaking generally) -- for example, a percentage chance, a stat buff, and the duration of the buff.

Certain Arcanes increase all of these stats per rank (making them scale exponentially), but we are changing it so that only one stat is affected by rank (making it scale linearly). The other stats will now be at the max-rank value regardless of the Arcane Rank, thereby buffing lower-rank Arcanes as a result.

;Arcane Pistoleer
On Pistol Headshot Kill: 60% (was 10%) chance for +17%/102% Ammo Efficiency for 12s (was 2s)

{{ver|30.9}}
*Fixed weapons with 1 bullet in their magazine (such as Vectis and Exergis) bypassing the Fire Rate limit if equipped with a max rank Arcane Pistoleer.

{{ver|25.8.1}}
*Fixed Arcane Pistoleer not giving infinite Ammo at 100% efficiency for weapons that fire more than one bullet at a time.

{{ver|25.7.7}}
*Fixed Arcane Pistoleer not listing “+1 Arcane Revive” at max Rank.

{{ver|25.7.6}}
*Introduced.
